goal: Human-Initialized Identity Memory in Real Candidate Streams
central_question: Can a single human identity initialization, together with the frozen learned identity memory from N72R18, reliably recover and maintain the same identity from a real SAM3 candidate stream over future frames?
central_question_zh: 一次人工身份确认后，N72R18 已验证的长期身份记忆，能否在真实 SAM3 候选流中持续找到并保持同一个人的身份？
